description: Machine-readable catalog of upstream apps available to HermesTV. Consumed by GET /api/upstream-apps to populate the Extensions panel in the UI.

apps.name: IPTVnator (Web)
apps.description: Open-source IPTV player supporting M3U and Xtream Codes. Web version runs in any modern browser including the Samsung Tizen browser on QN-class TVs.
apps.notes: Dave's primary IPTV player. Fork for UI customization.

apps.name: IPTVnator (Desktop)
apps.description: Electron-based desktop IPTV player. Same feature set as web version but runs as a native Windows app with file system access for local M3U playlists.
apps.notes: Dave's primary player on Windows PC. Same fork as web version.

apps.name: Jellyfin Web Client
apps.description: Official Jellyfin web UI. Connects to the Jellyfin server running on the VPS. Used on QN85/QN95 via the Tizen browser for full media library access.
apps.notes: Fork for Tizen-specific patches and custom HermesTV theme.

apps.name: IPTV Checker
apps.description: Node.js CLI and web tool for validating M3U playlists and checking stream availability. Used to audit Apollo Group / provider URLs before importing into Jellyfin.
apps.notes: Fork to track upstream bug fixes; may add HermesTV-specific validation scripts.

apps.name: Kodi
apps.description: Open-source home theater software. Supports IPTV via PVR add-ons. Used as a fallback player and for local library management. Very large project — reference only, not forked.
apps.notes: Reference only. Too large to fork usefully. Dave uses as fallback.

apps.name: PotPlayer
apps.description: High-performance Windows media player by KakaoTech. Supports M3U/M3U8 stream URLs directly. Excellent codec support and hardware acceleration. Freeware — no source available to fork.
apps.notes: Dave's secondary Windows player. No fork needed — closed source freeware.

apps.name: MPC-HC
apps.description: Media Player Classic - Home Cinema. Lightweight open-source Windows player. IPTV use requires manual stream URL entry. Maintained community fork of the original MPC.
apps.notes: Reference player for compatibility testing. No active HermesTV customization.

apps.name: Stream Recorder
apps.description: Browser extension and companion app for recording HLS/MPEG-TS streams from web pages. Useful for capturing IPTV streams for archival or testing.
apps.notes: Windows utility — no Tizen support. Used for stream capture on Dave's PC.

apps.name: Threadfin
apps.description: M3U proxy and EPG aggregator for Jellyfin and Plex (successor to xTeVe). Manages multiple provider M3U files, deduplicates channels, and serves a unified EPG XML feed. Required for Jellyfin Live TV.
apps.notes: Fork to track releases. EPG proxy for Jellyfin live TV on VPS.

apps.name: m3u-editor
apps.description: Web-based M3U playlist editor (Docker). Provides a UI for editing, filtering, reordering, and merging M3U playlists. Useful for managing HermesTV channel lists.
apps.notes: Fork for config customization. Runs on VPS, managed via Compose.

apps.name: xtreamfilter
apps.description: Xtream Codes stream filter proxy (Docker). Filters and rewrites Xtream API responses — useful for hiding provider credentials from client apps and filtering channel lists.
apps.notes: Fork for customization. Credential proxy — never commit real Xtream keys.

apps.name: Jellyfin Server
apps.description: Open-source media server. Core of the HermesTV VPS stack. Serves media library to all clients including Jellyfin Web on QN85/QN95 Tizen TV.
apps.notes: Already in Compose stack. Fork the web client (jellyfin-web), not the server.

apps.name: m3u4u
apps.description: Cloud-based M3U playlist builder and EPG merger. Allows creating custom playlists from multiple provider sources, adding a personal EPG, and generating a stable M3U URL. No installation required.
apps.notes: External web service. Useful for playlist management — account holds config, not credentials.

apps.name: Streamtest.in
apps.description: Browser-based HLS/DASH stream tester. Paste a stream URL and verify it plays in-browser. Useful for validating IPTV stream URLs before adding them to playlists.
apps.notes: Zero-install stream validation tool. Works in Tizen browser for quick TV-side testing.

apps.name: Wizju IPTV Player
apps.description: Browser-based IPTV player that accepts M3U URLs and plays streams directly in the browser. Designed with TV remote navigation in mind — works well on Smart TV browsers.
apps.notes: TV-remote-friendly web player. Tested on QN85 — works without keyboard.

apps.name: Purple WebPlayer
apps.description: Web-based IPTV player from PurpleTV. Supports M3U and Xtream Codes login. Runs fully in-browser with channel list navigation designed for TV UX.
apps.notes: Good fallback web player for QN85 if IPTVnator web has issues. No install needed.

apps.name: IPTV Smarters (Web)
apps.description: Browser-based version of IPTV Smarters player. Supports Xtream Codes login and M3U URL entry. Widely supported by IPTV providers for compatibility testing.
apps.notes: Good for provider-side compatibility testing. Free web version sufficient.

apps.name: Tunarr
apps.description: Fake HDHomeRun device that streams custom channel lineups to Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby. Used to build a curated live TV channel list from VOD content and IPTV streams.
apps.notes: Already running in Compose stack. Feeds channel lineup into Jellyfin live TV.

apps.name: Dispatcharr
apps.description: Stream routing and management layer. Routes IPTV stream requests to the appropriate provider backend. Part of the HermesTV VPS stack.
apps.notes: Already running in Compose stack. Core stream routing for HermesTV.

apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.description: Self-hosted web UI for interacting with local LLMs via Ollama or OpenAI-compatible APIs. Provides the chat interface for Hermes AI assistant (Sherri and Dave's AI companion).
apps.notes: Already running. Hermes UI — accessible from QN85 browser for on-TV chat.

apps.name: Ollama
apps.description: Local LLM runtime. Runs open-source language models locally on the VPS GPU or CPU. Backend engine for the Hermes AI assistant via Open WebUI.
apps.notes: Already running. Backend LLM engine — API only, no browser UI needed.
